content: Hi, the example listed seems to be solved using 0-based position.  If it is 1-based, the last 5 will contribute 25, thus the Output can never be 30.

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: I tested and it works.

Please specify "1-based" position in the Goal section, in addition to the Output section.

Please also add more test cases where N > 10. Alternatively, please adjust your constraint accordingly. Edit: I see @5DN1L has already pointed this out.

Thank you :)

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly by following the example there.

Goal
* Please explain the required task.

Input
* Please format all line numbers in <<bold>>.

* Please format all [[variables]].

Output
* Please change "Print the" to "The", and add the line number before it.

Constraints
* Please format all [[variables]].

* Please change 1000 to 100.

* Please change -10^9 to -100.

* Please change 10^9 to 100.

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Thanks.

Hello! Hope you're doing well. Thanks again for the detailed feedback! I’ve updated the statement formatting, shortened the Goal section, formatted the variables and line numbers correctly, adjusted the constraints, and added the requested `write answer` statement to the stub generator. If you have any other suggestions for improving the puzzle, I’d be happy to hear them!

Thank you for pointing that out! I’ll specify that the position is 1-based in the Goal section as well, and I’ll make sure the constraints and test cases are consistent with each other. I appreciate the additional feedback! ദ്ദി・ᴗ・)✧
Thank you, looks good to me :)
The task description is inconsistent with your solution.

You're right, thank you for pointing that one out! The statement describes a weighted sum, but some of the test outputs were still from an earlier version of the task. Now that I have updated the test cases and validators so that they'd match the described calculation and solution, please let me know if you have any more suggestions. ^^

Thank you for the prompt follow-up.

Just two more adjustments:

Constraints
* Please change the upper bound of N from 100 to 10.

Cases
* In Test 4, please change 50 to -50, and update the output accordingly. This is so that both Test 4 and Validator 4 expect a negative output.

Thanks again.
Also, consider using a more fitting name for the clash.

Thanks for the feedback! I’ll make the requested changes. Regarding the Clash name, though, could you clarify what you think would be a more fitting name? I’d be interested to know what you had in mind.
A title as simple as "Weighted Sum" will do the job, but you're welcome to use another title as well.
Got it! I’ll rename it to “Weighted Sum.” Thanks again for the suggestion and for all the feedback!
Please follow up the points on the constraint on N and Test 4 too.
Done! I’ve updated the upper bound of [[N]] to 10 and changed Test 4 to use -50, with the corresponding output updated to -518. Thanks again for catching that!

Glad to help, and thank you for following up.

I don't have further comments for now.

Thank you again for all your help and patience throughout the process! I really appreciate you taking the time to point everything out and help me improve the puzzle. Your feedbacks was genuinely very helpful. (๑'ᵕ'๑)⸝*
